channel.description: Daily DP Show episodes without C&R or Best Of clips.

item.title: Hour 3 – Adam Vinatieri, WNBA Hijacked
item.description:
Newly enshrined Pro Football Hall of Fame kicker Adam Vinatieri drops by to talk about his experiences in Canton over the weekend and address any fallout from his speech on Saturday. And DP talks about the issues plaguing the WNBA and the people trying to use the league to promote their own agendas.

item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Roger Craig Dementia Diagnosis, Kirk Herbstreit
item.description:
Hall of Fame running back Roger Craig reveals his vascular dementia diagnosis, and DP talks about how we lose track of the lives of the greats of yesteryear when they leave our televisions. College football broadcaster Kirk Herbstreit joins Dan to talk about the failure of the college sports bill and how SEC fans are getting tired of the Big Ten crushing them as Kirk’s dog Peter steals the show.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Pro Football Hall of Fame Ceremony Was Fun, Aaron Rodgers Comes Full Circle
item.description:
Dan weighs in on the Pro Football Hall of Fame ceremony and has no problem with Adam Vinatieri taking shots during his acceptance speech. And Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers admits part of the reason he returned for this season was to play for Mike McCarthy again.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Scottie Pippen Still Begging for His Flowers, Bruce Feldman
item.description:
Scottie Pippen makes his argument for his place above LeBron James, but Dan isn’t buying it, largely because he doesn’t view the Bulls as Scottie’s team in the same way that it was Michael Jordan’s team. College football insider Bruce Feldman joins Dan to discuss the impending college football season and what we should expect from Penn State, what’s on stake for Bill Belichick at North Carolina, and the ongoing slap-fight between the Big Ten and the SEC that also includes their media partners.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – No Haters Needed, Charles Davis
item.description:
New Michigan head coach Kyle Whittingham doesn’t see the value in playing up the hate in the Michigan-Ohio State rivalry, and Dan agrees with him as he wonders how much that rivalry really needs the heat these days. College football analyst Charles Davis joins Dan to talk about the biggest questions facing college football this season, the Big Ten versus the SEC, and who has the best uniforms right now in college football.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Cowboys Sign Quinnen Williams, NBA Christmas Presents
item.description:
The Dallas Cowboys agree to extend defensive tackle Quinnen Williams, and while the clock is ticking for “America’s Team,” Dan thinks they can do some real damage this year. After giving the NFL the open door to Christmas, the NBA pulls out all the stops for their holiday day game schedule with the LeBron James led Sixers taking on his former squad Lakers in Los Angeles.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2-How does Kyler Murray shape the NFC North, JJ Watt
item.description:
With Kyler Murray getting the nod over JJ McCarthy to start in Minnesota, the NFC North division is coming into picture. Is this enough to put the Vikings back on the map? Is this last call for the Lions? The Lakers get sold to new ownership. Former Texans pass rusher and CBS lead football analyst JJ Watt joins Dan to talk about Murray getting the nod, talks about the most elusive quarterbacks he tried to sack and how he’s moving into the booth with Jim Nantz.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3- Why are the Lakers selling again? Ross Tucker
item.description:
Surprise news on Wednesday morning as the Los Angeles Lakers are sold once more, this time to Joshua Kushner and Bob Iger. Why did this happen now and what does it mean for the Lakers? Football analyst Ross Tucker joins Dan and discusses the decision in Minnesota to move on to Kyler Murray at quarterback over JJ McCarthy, how in he is on Baker Mayfield as a quarterback and more football topics as the NFL looms large as preseason begins Thursday.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1-JJ McCarthy gets benched, Kyle Wittingham doesn’t embrace rivalry hate
item.description:
The Minnesota Vikings announce that they will start quarterback Kyler Murray over JJ McCarthy, which isn’t really big news to Dan as it was expected when he was signed, but Dan finds the reaction to McCarthy’s benching to be interesting. If he’s kicked to the curb it’s a big draft whiff. New Michigan head coach Kyle Wittingham doesn’t really bring hate to the Ohio State rivalry, and Dan supports him because that’s not who he is.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.description:
DP out Tony Reali talked with Kevin Clark about the doomsday clock on Jalen Hurts, Cousins and Mendoza in Las Vegas.

item.description:
DP out Tony Reali in, Tony talked with Sister Mary Jo Sobieck who throw out the first pitch at Pope Night during the Chicago White Sox game and Ramona Shelburne. They talked about the Los Angeles Lakers being sold and Russell Westbrook  retirement.

item.title: Hour 3 – Man Cave Battle, Dave Winfield
item.description:
Tony Reali sets the Danettes against each other in a sports game show that strongly resembles another famous sports game show, testing their knowledge on sports. Tony also is joined by his idol, former Yankees star Dave Winfield and talks to him about his impact on the game, his new book and inspiring others, plus how often he’d lose his grip on his bat.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Jon Blau, Courtney Cronin
item.description:
Reporter Jon Blau joins Toni Reali to discuss the new legal battle between LSU and former Tigers’ QB Jayden Daniels in a fight over his jersey number, Name Image and Likeness, and Heisman Trophy. How did this situation get to this? Reporter Courtney Cronin then joins the show and discusses the ongoing developments for the Chicago Bears to find a new stadium, plus how Bears coach Ben Johnson is writing a lot of checks with his mouth he’s hoping his players will be able to cash this season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Preseason Love, Mendoza Madness
item.description:
Tony Reali sits in for Dan and reacts to the NFL preseason hitting hot and heavy on Thursday. It’s that time of year where you just fall in love with a guy – maybe Cardinals running back Jeremiyah Love? Reali also talks about the instability of the Raiders quarterback position and asks if Fernando Mendoza can bring balance and take the reins.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3: A Cowboys Super Bowl Is Different?
item.description:
In Hour 3 of the show, Jonas Knox, Brady Quinn, & LaVar Arrington fill in for the guys and discuss contract negotiations that could become a a distraction or a new deal with Christian Gonzalez's deal still up in the air. Plus, the guys discuss Von Miller claiming that winning a Super Bowl in Dallas would be different than when he won in Denver and in Los Angeles, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 2: No Value For LIV Golfers?
item.description:
In Hour 2 of the show, Jonas Knox, Brady Quinn, & LaVar Arrington fill in for the guys and discuss the ongoing QB situation with DeShaun Watson & Shedeur Sanders and how they both do not feel pressure. Plus, the guys go over Rory Mcllroy claiming that LIV Tour Golfers coming back to the PGA provide no value, and more!!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 1: 5th Year Eligibility Granted
item.description:
On this episode of The Dan Patrick Show, Jonas Knox, Brady Quinn, & LaVar Arrington fill in for the guys and go over some NFL rookies have been granted a 5th year eligibility to play in college after getting cut by NFL teams. Plus, the guys discuss Vita Vea's contract extension with the Bucs, a weird meal for athletes that involves a sandwich and a honey bun, and more!

item.title: Hour 3: Coach Prime Has Fallen Off + Former NFL QB Shaun King
item.description:
The Odd Couple Rob Parker and Kelvin Washington are in for the DP Show! Rob and Kelvin debate whether the idea that ‘Coach Prime’ Deion Sanders has turned around the Colorado football program is overstated. Plus, former NFL quarterback and FOX Sports Radio NFL analyst Shaun King swings by to discuss why he’s so high on Las Vegas Raiders rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza, why some quarterbacks are better served sitting their entire rookie season, and much more!

#oddcouple

item.title: Hour 2: CBS Sports national baseball writer Julian McWilliams & and FOX Sports football analyst Robert Smith
item.description:
The Odd Couple Rob Parker and Kelvin Washington are in for the DP Show! Rob and Kelvin are joined by CBS Sports national baseball writer Julian McWilliams for an extensive conversation on the NL MVP race between Pete Crow-Armstrong and Shohei Ohtani, the idea that Ohtani needs to stop being a two-way player to preserve his health, the surging New York Yankees, and much more! Later, former NFL All-Pro running back and FOX Sports football analyst Robert Smith checks in to discuss why the Cleveland Browns won’t be starting Shedeur Sanders, the NIL problem in college sports, the recent trend of NFL players going back to play college football again, and much more!

#oddcouple

item.title: Hour 1: The Raiders Better Start Fernando Mendoza in Week 1
item.description:
The Odd Couple Rob Parker and Kelvin Washington are in for the DP Show! Rob and Kelvin debate whether the Las Vegas Raiders would be better served by starting Fernando Mendoza in Week 1, argue the real reason why the Cleveland Browns are set to start Deshaun Watson over Shedeur Sanders, and tell us if joint practices have any real value in today’s NFL.
